entities.justification: Identified as royal secretary and donatary protesting against the council through a proxy ('Generosi Domini Pauli Szorbic donatarii').
Deceased individual whose estate is sequestered and disputed ('morte memorati Francisci Henk relicta').
The King of Poland referenced via his royal title ('Sacrae Regiae Maiestatis Domini Domini sui Clementissimi').
The city of Lviv mentioned in the city council's title and 'Civitatis vero eiusdem Leopoliensis'.
The consular office of Lviv deciding on the sequester of Henk's estate.
